x-purpose: #1847 B. Hand-written input of the public network support matrix; `dart run tool/build_public_network_contract.dart` renders contracts/public_network/generated/support-matrix.json from it, the catalogue and the sha256 of every source, artifact and evidence file named. A row states what was EXECUTED, never what is assumed: fixture conformance on the Dart VM is not a device run.

axes.app_build: The Deskilo client build. Its version and SHA are release metadata; a build label grants nothing and proves no compatibility.
axes.protocol: deskilo.public-network protocol versions and per-operation versions, from the catalogue.
axes.internal_schema: deskilo_schema_version() of the server. Private: never part of the descriptor; a compatible internal change needs no client release.
axes.business_revision: Not applicable yet: no published operation carries a price, offer or policy revision.
axes.authorization: SQL grants, RLS and RPC checks on the target. A negotiated version or capability grants nothing.

server_profiles.summary: A server from before negotiation: no descriptor (PGRST202), version 1 of every baseline operation, no revalidation.
The descriptor is published; participant mutations revalidate x-deskilo-operation; an unlabelled request is the operation's unlabelled version.

client_profiles.summary: The released client before negotiation: reads cards with the checkpoint A adapter (or none), sends no operation header.
This client: negotiates before each participant mutation and names the version.
